{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
duplicate_count = duplicate_patients.sum()

duplicate_patients_info = df[duplicate_patients].groupby('patient_id').size()

# Check the sample_seq for duplicates to see if we need to deduplicate
duplicate_rows = df[duplicate_patients]
duplicate_rows_sorted = duplicate_rows.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=False)

duplicate_rows_sorted.head(10)"}
